data.long_meaning: Gottlieb is a German name composed of two elements: Gott, meaning God, and Leib, meaning reward or property. The name reflects the belief that God bestows blessings upon His followers. The name Gottlieb carries the meaning “God's reward” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German. Parents who choose Gottlieb usually hope their child will grow to embody god's reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
